entities.summary: Kaya is the fifth largest city in Burkina Faso, lying northeast of Ouagadougou, to which it is connected by railway. It is a centre for weaving and tanning. Kaya is a city in West Africa. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
